nfl.oneThing: Rams receiver Puka Nacua is expected to miss the rest of the regular season and the playoffs, with sources saying his MCL recovery is four to five months.

headlines.title: Nacua out four to five months after knee surgery
headlines.summary: Sources told ESPN that Puka Nacua's MCL recovery is four to five months, which rules him out of the playoffs. The surgery was on Tuesday, and his knee was clean apart from the MCL. In seven games he had 70 catches for 715 yards and four touchdowns. He is also serving a three-game suspension on injured reserve, and the NFL didn't know he'd had surgery when it imposed it. Coach Sean McVay said a postseason return hasn't been considered.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Rams are 6-4 and will have to make the playoffs without their star receiver.

headlines.title: Cardinals start 40-year-old Josh Johnson
headlines.summary: Arizona will start Josh Johnson at Kansas City on Sunday, aged 40 years and 191 days. Rookie Carson Beck is out with a back injury. This is the fourth different starter the Cardinals have used in four weeks. Jacoby Brissett was traded to Baltimore, and Gardner Minshew II needs season-ending elbow surgery. Johnson would be the second-oldest non-specialist to play for Arizona, behind Jim Thorpe in 1928.
headlines.whyItMatters: Arizona are 3-7 and 15th in the NFC, so the quarterback situation is the main story.

nba.oneThing: Tyler Herro scored a career-high 50 points, but the 76ers held on for a 132–129 win over the 1–16 Bucks.

headlines.title: Herro's 50 not enough as Sixers hang on
headlines.summary: Tyler Herro scored a career-high 50 points, including a contested fadeaway three at the end of regulation that would have tied the game. An official review ruled he released it after the buzzer, so Philadelphia won 132–129. Joel Embiid had 26 points, 17 rebounds and nine assists, and LeBron James scored 13 of his 21 points in the fourth quarter. The Sixers nearly blew a 10-point late lead, and Jaylen Brown and Dean Wade were out with left hamstring injuries. The win moved them to 14-3, tied for the NBA's best record and their best 17-game start since 2000–01, according to ESPN.
headlines.whyItMatters: Philadelphia lead the East, but their late-game control is the question. Milwaukee are 1–16 after 13 straight losses.

headlines.title: Redick's halftime talk lifts Lakers past Kings
headlines.summary: The Lakers trailed the last-place Kings at halftime, then rallied for a 106–104 win. Coach JJ Redick ripped the team's lack of fight at the break. Luka Dončić had 25 points and eight assists, and Walker Kessler added 15 points, seven rebounds and three blocks. Austin Reaves missed a fourth straight game with a bruised left heel. Redick said he hopes Reaves returns in the next two games.
headlines.whyItMatters: Los Angeles lead the West at 14-3. Rob Pelinka says the team will be active at the trade deadline.

headlines.title: Warriors without Curry
headlines.summary: Stephen Curry is out with a right abdominal injury, and Golden State have lost five straight to go 8-8. A CBS Sports column argues that his absence shows how much the team relies on him. The column also says he isn't going to win MVP for a number of reasons.
headlines.whyItMatters: Golden State are 8-8 and 11th in the West, so their next few games will show how they cope without Curry.

Philadelphia almost gave up a 10-point late lead, and Embiid's 26 points, 17 rebounds and nine assists carried them through.

recaps.keyLine: Sengun 28 pts, 11 reb, 10 ast · VanVleet 25 pts, 1 reb, 9 ast · Jokic 26 pts, 7 reb, 11 ast · Braun 19 pts, 5 reb, 3 ast, 4 stl
recaps.text: Denver's Nikola Jokić had 26 points and 11 assists, and Christian Braun added four steals. Alperen Sengun had 28 points, 11 rebounds and 10 assists for Houston, and Fred VanVleet added 25 points, but it wasn't enough. Ime Udoka called his team 'mentally fragile' after the loss.

recaps.keyLine: Hunter 30 pts, 6 reb, 2 ast, 5 3PM · Sabonis 19 pts, 16 reb, 1 ast · Doncic 25 pts, 4 reb, 8 ast · Kessler 15 pts, 7 reb, 2 ast, 3 blk
recaps.text: The Lakers trailed the last-place Kings at halftime and needed a second-half comeback. Redick's halftime message was blunt, and Luka Dončić's 25 points and eight assists did the rest. De'Andre Hunter scored 30 points with five threes for Sacramento, but the Kings couldn't close it out.

recaps.keyLine: Davis 36 pts, 11 reb, 3 ast · Dybantsa 20 pts, 10 reb, 6 ast · Powell 16 pts, 3 reb, 2 ast · Hield 15 pts, 4 reb, 0 ast
recaps.text: Anthony Davis scored 36 points with 11 rebounds, and AJ Dybantsa added 20 points and 10 rebounds for Washington. Trae Young had 16 points, five assists and three steals. Chicago's Norman Powell scored 16 and Tre Jones handed out seven assists, but the Bulls couldn't close the gap.

contextCard.title: How the NBA trade deadline works
contextCard.body: The trade deadline is the last date teams can make trades during the season. After it passes, most deals are closed until the off-season. Teams that want to add players have a limited window, so the deadline is when contenders make their biggest moves.
